name: 回復アイテム_おにぎり_v1.png
prompt:
Use case: game-asset
Asset type: single pickup sprite for a 2D Sengoku beat-'em-up
Input images: Image 1 is only the game's painted sprite style reference; do not reproduce any people.
Composition/framing: one complete object centered in one square 256x256 game cell, resting on the ground and occupying about 70-80% of the canvas, at least 20px clear margin.
Style/medium: detailed painted anime-realistic 2D arcade sprite, crisp dark outline, cel-shaded highlights, period materials, consistent with Image 1.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat pure RGB(255,0,255) magenta (#FF00FF), no floor or cast shadow.
Constraints: one pickup only, fully visible and physically plausible; no hands/characters, no text/letters/numbers/labels, border, extra props, glow, or watermark.
Primary request: one freshly packed triangular Japanese onigiri rice ball as a game recovery pickup, with a neat dark nori band around its lower third and clearly textured white rice. Set it on one corner so the triangle silhouette reads clearly, no plate or wrapper.
Materials/textures: individual soft rice grains, matte nori.
Avoid: face, character, multiple food pieces, plate, label, text, chopsticks.
